notes.title: Patch 2.3
notes.content:
• The game now runs at the refresh rate of your screen. Doing Nothing has never been smoother!
• Your PC will no longer go into standby while doing Nothing

notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content:
•Changed required number of players for a Battle Royale game to 2
•Improved leaderboard anti cheat

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
•Added Lobby Browser for Together Mode. Players can now create their own lobbies and join any available lobby that is not full.
•The host of each lobby is now displayed in the player list in-game
•Added new achievements for doing nothing for 4 weeks, 12 weeks, 24 weeks and an entire year!
•UI Improvements
•Localization Improvements
•Fixed some crashes

------------
This version is NOT compatible with games started in previous versions. If you wish to join older games, you can right click the game in your library, go to properties -> betas and select "legacy". This will download the previous version which is compatible with older games.

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
•Improved Netcode. Lag should be greatly reduced.
•Improved Japanese and Korean translation
•Added new Deep Purple DLC

notes.title: Patch 1.9
notes.content:
•Added Dark Theme DLC
(More themes coming soon!)
•Removed 8 player Together mode


Update 1.9b - February 13th:

•Added light and cute theme DLCs
•Fixed an issue that caused achievements to be unlocked before the required time was actually reached

notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.content:
•Together Mode and Battle Royale are now playable with up to 20 players again.
 After updating to this version, you can also earn achievements in 20 players together mode.
•8 players Together Mode will stay in the game for now, so the progress of already started 8 player servers won't be lost

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.content:
•Added experimental 20 player Together mode. This mode may have some issues or glitches, but please play it as much as possible so we can test it and fix issues. Achievements are disabled in this mode.
•Country codes are now displayed in the flag selection menu
•Added a link to our Discord Server to the main menu

-----------------
This version is compatible with "Together" games that were started in version 1.5, so you can easily join already existing games and keep adding to that timer!

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
•It's now possible to change your flag in the main menu
•Added hungarian translation (Translation by kozmonauta)

-------------
This version is compatible with Servers using 1.5, so you can easily join already existing servers and keep adding to that timer!

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
•The game now tracks the overall time that you have done nothing and displays it in the main menu
•Achievements now count the overall time instead of session time
•Added ukrainian language to the game (Translation by Choven)
•Japanese translation improvements (Translation by nattsuiy)

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
•Temporarily reduced Players per Server from 20 to 8

Our data shows that most issues in Together Mode have occured whenever more than 8 players were present in a server.
We have temporarily reduced the player count to 8 and will set it back to 20 as soon as possible.
Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 and statement on current Issues in Together Mode
notes.content:
Patch 1.3:
•Improvements to netcode
•Smaller stability improvements
•Reduced Memory usage

-----------------------------

We are aware of some issues that are randomly occuring in Together Mode, including:

-Players not able to join the Server (stuck in "Connect to Server" screen)
-Combined time resetting after a new player joins
-Combined time randomly jumping up to ridiculously high numbers

We are actively working on fixing these issues, thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
•Fixed some crashes
•Improved multiplayer stability

Please let us know if you still experience crashes or weird Multiplayer behaviour

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
•Improved networking and server logic

This should hopefully fix the issue that caused players to be stuck in the "Joining server" screen.
